description: This file defines a final class 'FilterUsingXForwardedHeaders' that implements logic to modify the server request's URI based on trusted X-Forwarded headers. It manages trust configuration for proxies and headers, and adjusts the URI scheme, host, and port accordingly.

classes.name: FilterUsingXForwardedHeaders
classes.description: Final class that filters server requests based on X-Forwarded headers, trusting proxy configurations, and updating URI accordingly.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor initializing trusted proxies and headers.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokable method that modifies the request's URI based on trusted headers if the request originates from a trusted proxy.

methods.name: trustProxies
methods.description: Static method to create an instance trusting specific proxy CIDRs and headers.

methods.name: trustAny
methods.description: Static method to trust any X-Forwarded headers from any address; equivalent to trustProxies(['*']).

methods.name: trustReservedSubnets
methods.description: Static method to trust headers from reserved subnets and localhost addresses.

methods.name: isFromTrustedProxy
methods.description: Checks if a remote IP address matches the list of trusted proxies.

methods.name: validateTrustedHeaders
methods.description: Validates that given headers are among the allowed headers.

methods.name: normalizeProxiesList
methods.description: Normalizes the proxy list, expanding wildcards and validating CIDR formats.

methods.name: validateProxyCIDR
methods.description: Validates if a string is a correctly formatted IP or CIDR notation for IPv4 or IPv6.
